name: AI-TAgent Request Intake
description: Local, explicitly authorized human request intake. No task execution or Octop delivery.

settings_schema.header: Do not put secrets or sensitive information in slash commands. Server audit logs may contain the full command even when intake is rejected, and have retention separate from the plugin's 7-day KV expiry. Review every audit sink, export and backup before enabling intake. Disabled by default. Configure a single test team/channel, an existing digital employee Bot, and allowed requester IDs. These settings grant intake access only, not Octop execution permission.
